external_datasets_note: No external dataset is needed: the workload is synthetic and generated locally from recorded seeds. No dataset was downloaded in M0.

synthetic_datasets.status: implemented (M2); used by exploratory runs only
synthetic_datasets.description: Synthetic catalogue table items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, category INTEGER, price_cents INTEGER, payload TEXT) in SQLite, WAL mode
synthetic_datasets.seed: 20261124 used for exploratory runs (config default); to be confirmed at the protocol freeze
synthetic_datasets.redistribution: Not bundled; regenerated deterministically by script. Small fixtures may be committed under the project licence.
synthetic_datasets.sha256_definition: SHA-256 over the concatenated fixed-length JSON encodings of all rows in id order (data.build_database), independent of the SQLite file layout and of the index

request_sequences.status: implemented (M2): data.request_stream, seeds from runner.block_seeds and runner.connection_seeds
request_sequences.description: Seeded request streams: 98 percent reads, 2 percent writes, Zipf s=0.99 over a seeded key permutation (planning values)
request_sequences.seed_policy: derived from the study seed and block index; recorded per run
